message.subject: Microsoft Build’s Session Scheduler is live. Plus, .NET 11 Preview 4
message.html:
New learning resources for VS Code, Work IQ, and Azure.

Having trouble viewing this email? | View as web page
Getting Ready for Microsoft Build

Plan your Microsoft Build experience, explore the latest .NET 11 preview, and discover new learning resources across VS Code, Microsoft Work IQ, and for building AI‑driven applications on Azure.
 
 
Featured
Microsoft Build / June 2–3 / Session Scheduler now open >
Create and save your personalized event agenda.
New this year, digital attendees can access online guided labs led by Microsoft experts.
 
What's New
.NET 11 Preview 4 is now available >
Explore performance improvements across C# 15 and Blazor, plus a .NET MAUI update that now runs on CoreCLR by default for Android, iOS, and Mac Catalyst.
 
Codex vs. Opus: A side-by-side comparison in Copilot CLI >
Burke Holland compares the two models as they tackle the same task in real time, showing reasoning, decomposition, and edge case handling.
 
The Shift podcast: Is Postgres the wave of the future? >
The Azure Database team explores how agentic AI is reshaping database choices, why ease of adoption, open‑source ecosystems, and data context are driving renewed interest in Postgres.
 
Learning
New Course: Develop AI cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure >
Build skills for AI-driven applications on Azure, covering containerized compute, data services, event-driven workflows, and secure, observable architectures.
 
New VS Code with GitHub Copilot Learn content >
Start learning agent-first development in VS Code with a guided video series, hands-on exercises, and real-world examples.
 
Explore the Microsoft Work IQ GitHub repo >
Learn how the Work IQ CLI and MCP server are implemented to connect AI agents with Microsoft 365 data.
 
Events Find community events >
Before You Build: A Microsoft Build preview / Live and on demand >
Get guidance on planning your Build experience. You’ll create a simple agenda to get the most value whether you attend Build live or watch on demand.
 
Configure your own upgrades with GitHub Copilot SDK / May 27 / Online >
Integrate GitHub Copilot agentic workflows to customize developer tooling upgrades using your own code and MCP servers.
 
Agent League Hackathon / Register by June 12 / Online >
Turn what you learn at Microsoft Build into a working AI agent. Compete across multiple challenge tracks and climb the leaderboard for $55k USD in prizes.
 
AI Skills Fest / June 8-12 / Online >
Go from AI-assisted coding with GitHub to building and orchestrating agents in Foundry. Free to join, with opportunities to build, compete, and win prizes.
 
POSETTE: An event for Postgres / June 16-18 / Online >
Livestreams covering Postgres app development including performance, scaling, graph data, AI agents, and Postgres 19.
 
Subscribe
Sign up for the Microsoft.Source newsletter for curated monthly developer community content.
 

Unsubscribe | Privacy Statement

Redmond, WA 98052
